fib: ______ is a reflection of divine wisdom in created things.
Natural law for him is a reflection of divine wisdom in created things.
______ is the study of questions concerning power, justice, rights, law, and other issues pertaining to governance.
Political thought is the study of questions concerning power, justice, rights, law, and other issues pertaining to governance.
______ are considered equal and the members of the laity are also churchmen.
Consequently all priests are considered equal and the members of the laity are also churchmen.
______ is the divine right reason of Supreme Jupiter (Roman god), powerful to establish right and wrong.
The primal law for Cicero is the divine right reason of Supreme Jupiter (Roman god), powerful to establish right and wrong.

The Soma or body refers to the producers, that is, the workers in the society.
